evidence.title: Font Finder by WhatFontIs 🔎 Identify fonts by image

name: WhatFontIs
summary: Font finder: upload an image of text and AI matches it against 1.2M+ free and commercial fonts.
description: Identify a font from any image: upload, paste or drop a picture, optionally split letters in the built-in image editor, and the AI returns an exact match or 60+ similar fonts with links to free downloads or commercial licences. The site also hosts a browsable font database, a webfont generator, font pairing and PDF font tools. Free plan identifies up to 5 fonts per day; PRO membership gives unlimited ad-free searches, richer results and API access.
contains: PRO: unlimited searches, up to 100 results, no ads
image editor to split letters and adjust contrast
Chrome extension for fonts on web pages
webfont generator, font pairing and PDF font finder tools
